item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "3a0c0fa956dea10d97e4178e3297b467f1fad8460a50c9f4da192b878d08a80a",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For data : ℝ → E, the left-hand limit at a is left, the right-hand limit at a is right, and left ≠ right.",
      "effect_on_target": "The medium hypothesis includes both one-sided limits and distinct material limits. The conclusion repeats this condition and asserts the corresponding condition for initialState.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For every real x < 0, data(x) = leftState, and for every real x > 0, data(x) = rightState.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires initialState to be constant on each entire open half-line, with no condition at zero; this hypothesis is also repeated in the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "The function assigning leftState when x < 0, rightState when x > 0, and valueAtOrigin when x = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "The final existential conclusion represents initialState exactly as this function for some originState.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction: both propositions hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "All components of the nested conclusion are asserted simultaneously; the dependency definitions also combine their conditions conjunctively.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "ContinuousAt",
      "meaning": "Continuity of f at x, defined as convergence of f along nhds(x) to nhds(f(x)).",
      "effect_on_target": "The conclusion denies continuity at zero separately for medium and initialState.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses exact state values on the half-lines and equality of initialState with the entire three-branch function, not merely agreement near zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over the specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "For each collection of universally quantified data satisfying the hypotheses, supplies an originState in State making the function equality hold.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Filter.Tendsto",
      "meaning": "Convergence of f from filter l₁ to filter l₂, defined by map(f,l₁) ≤ l₂; equivalently, the preimage of each l₂-large set is l₁-large.",
      "effect_on_target": "Encodes the scalar-component and paired one-sided limits through the specified source and destination filters.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Inequality, defined as the negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires distinct state limits explicitly and distinct material limits through LocalDef001, and repeats both inequalities in the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Not",
      "meaning": "Logical negation: the proposition implies False.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses inequality and the failure of continuity at zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Extracts the value assigned to a natural-number literal by its OfNat instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Together with the supplied real zero instances, interprets every displayed zero as the real number 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Prod",
      "meaning": "The Cartesian product type of ordered pairs.",
      "effect_on_target": "The combined function and its limits take values in Material × State.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Prod.mk",
      "meaning": "Constructs the ordered pair of its first and second arguments.",
      "effect_on_target": "Pairs medium(x) with initialState(x), and pairs the corresponding left and right limit values in the same order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform-space structure contained in a pseudometric-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in obtaining the real domain topology from the supplied real pseudometric structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number type ℝ, used as an external mathematical primitive here; its construction is not supplied.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both functions are defined on the entire real line, and every input quantified in the half-line conditions is real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Real.instPreorder",
      "meaning": "The inferred preorder structure on ℝ, conventionally its usual order; the inference is not expanded.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the order underlying the intervals used for left-hand and right-hand convergence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero instance selecting Real.zero as the distinguished real zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the interface and continuity evaluation point to 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric-space structure with distance d(x,y) = |x − y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual metric topology on the real domain through the uniform-space and topology projections.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Set.Iio",
      "meaning": "The strict lower interval Iio(b) = {x : x < b}.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts each left-hand approach to inputs strictly less than the limit point, specifically x < 0 in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Set.Ioi",
      "meaning": "The strict upper interval Ioi(b) = {x : b < x}.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts each right-hand approach to inputs strictly greater than the limit point, specifically x > 0 in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "T2Space",
      "meaning": "The standard Hausdorff separation property: distinct points admit disjoint open neighborhoods. The packet supplies its type but omits its defining field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts both codomains to Hausdorff spaces, supporting uniqueness of limits and the incompatibility of distinct one-sided limits with continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "TopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "A topology on a type, conventionally specified by open sets satisfying the topology axioms; its fields are not displayed.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both codomains carry arbitrary supplied topologies used by all limit and continuity assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology carried by a uniform-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Completes the selection of the topology on ℝ used by nhds, nhdsWithin, and ContinuousAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Builds the interpretation of the numeral 0 from the zero element of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the zero literals in the target equal to the real zero supplied by Real.instZero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "instTopologicalSpaceProd",
      "meaning": "The product topology, constructed from the topologies induced by the two coordinate projections.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the paired limit assertions convergence in the product topology on Material × State.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "nhds",
      "meaning": "Conventionally the neighborhood filter at a point, consisting of sets containing an open neighborhood of that point. The displayed body wrapped✝.1 does not expose its construction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines all destination filters, the unrestricted source filters for continuity, and the source neighborhood component of one-sided convergence. The translation uses its standard neighborhood-filter interpretation, which cannot be independently reconstructed from the displayed body.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "nhdsWithin",
      "meaning": "The infimum of nhds(x) and the principal filter of s, representing neighborhoods of x restricted to s under the standard interpretation of nhds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the punctured left and right approach filters at zero; neither includes zero as an allowed approach input.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Extracts the strict comparison relation from an LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses the sign tests selecting the half-line conditions and the branches of LocalDef003.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Real.decidableLT",
      "meaning": "Supplies a decision of each real strict comparison a < b.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the conditional definition of LocalDef003; it adds no mathematical inequality assumption or numerical algorithm requirement to the proposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict-order instance selecting Real.lt as the comparison relation on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets x < 0 and 0 < x in the state assumptions and piecewise function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "ite",
      "meaning": "Selects its first value when the proposition is true and its second value when it is false.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes LocalDef003 equal to leftState for negative inputs, rightState for positive inputs, and originState only at zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify arbitrary types Material and State, possibly in different universes.",
      "Equip Material and State with arbitrary topologies and assume each is Hausdorff.",
      "Universally quantify functions medium : ℝ → Material and initialState : ℝ → State.",
      "Universally quantify leftMaterial and rightMaterial in Material, and leftState and rightState in State.",
      "Under the three hypotheses below, the final conclusion existentially quantifies originState in State. This witness is chosen for the given data, not uniformly before those data."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "As x tends to 0 through negative reals, medium(x) tends to leftMaterial; as x tends to 0 through positive reals, medium(x) tends to rightMaterial; and leftMaterial ≠ rightMaterial.",
      "For every real x < 0, initialState(x) = leftState, and for every real x > 0, initialState(x) = rightState.",
      "leftState ≠ rightState."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "The medium has left-hand limit leftMaterial and right-hand limit rightMaterial at 0, with leftMaterial ≠ rightMaterial; simultaneously, initialState has left-hand limit leftState and right-hand limit rightState at 0, with leftState ≠ rightState.",
      "In Material × State with its product topology, (medium(x), initialState(x)) tends to (leftMaterial, leftState) as x → 0 from below and to (rightMaterial, rightState) as x → 0 from above; both leftMaterial ≠ rightMaterial and leftState ≠ rightState hold.",
      "For every real x < 0, initialState(x) = leftState, and for every real x > 0, initialState(x) = rightState.",
      "medium is not continuous at 0.",
      "initialState is not continuous at 0.",
      "There exists originState in State such that, as functions on all of ℝ, initialState equals the function taking leftState for x < 0, originState for x = 0, and rightState for x > 0."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "A left-hand limit at a uses the filter nhdsWithin(a, {x ∈ ℝ : x < a}); a right-hand limit uses nhdsWithin(a, {x ∈ ℝ : a < x}).",
      "Under the standard neighborhood-filter interpretation, f(x) → L from the left at 0 means that for each neighborhood U of L there is δ > 0 such that −δ < x < 0 implies f(x) ∈ U; the right-hand version uses 0 < x < δ.",
      "LocalDef001 includes distinctness of the two limits in addition to existence of the specified one-sided limits.",
      "LocalDef002 specifies global constancy on both open half-lines and leaves the value at the origin unrestricted.",
      "LocalDef003(left, origin, right)(x) is left when x < 0, right when x > 0, and origin otherwise, which on ℝ means x = 0.",
      "Continuity at zero means convergence to the function's actual value at zero along the full neighborhood filter of zero.",
      "The existential function equality forces originState = initialState(0); hence the witness is determined by the given function, although uniqueness is not explicitly asserted."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For any two Hausdorff topological spaces Material and State, any functions medium : ℝ → Material and initialState : ℝ → State, and any specified left and right values, suppose medium has the specified distinct one-sided limits at zero, initialState equals leftState everywhere on the negative half-line and rightState everywhere on the positive half-line, and leftState and rightState are distinct. Then both functions have the specified distinct one-sided limits at zero, their ordered pair has the corresponding ordered-pair one-sided limits in the product topology, both component inequalities hold, the global half-line formula for initialState holds, neither function is continuous at zero, and initialState is exactly the three-branch function with the specified left and right values and some value at zero."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "Material and State are arbitrary Hausdorff topological spaces; no metric, vector-space, scalar, order, or other algebraic structure on either codomain is assumed.",
    "The functions are defined on all real inputs. The limit and discontinuity assertions concern only the fixed point 0.",
    "The initialState assumptions require exact constancy on the entire negative and positive half-lines, which is stronger than merely having one-sided limits or being locally constant near zero.",
    "No value is prescribed for medium(0) or initialState(0), and neither value must equal a corresponding one-sided limit.",
    "No constancy of medium on either half-line, continuity away from zero, differentiability, or quantitative convergence rate is encoded.",
    "The proposition is conditional. Empty codomains provide no choices for the bound values, and a codomain with fewer than two points cannot satisfy its required inequality; such cases yield no substantive instance.",
    "With the standard topology on ℝ, the left and right approach filters at zero are nontrivial, so these one-sided limit assertions are not vacuous because of an empty approach domain.",
    "The existential originState describes the already given initialState; it does not assert one common origin value for all admissible functions.",
    "The object names do not encode physical interpretations, evolution equations, interface laws, conservation laws, or any additional relationship between medium and initialState."
  ],
  "ambiguities": [
    "The nhds body is only wrapped✝.1, whose referent is absent. Its exact semantics cannot be independently recovered from the supplied body. The mathematical translation therefore uses the standard neighborhood-filter interpretation.",
    "Several external primitives are supplied only by type or through unexpanded references: in particular the fields of T2Space and TopologicalSpace, the construction of Real, and the inferred real preorder. Their standard mathematical meanings are used, but the packet does not expose enough implementation detail to independently verify these meanings or the compatibility of the two displayed real-order instances."
  ]
}
